text.description_html:
Canaropa FP225-50-630, Round Satin Stainless Steel Pocket Door Pull

This 2 Inch Round Stainless Steel Flush Pull is great if you like the look of stainless steel but want to stay away from the sharp lines of most modern door hardware. It features a satin stainless steel finish that really pops against dark colored doors. The small, 2 inch diameter of this finger pull makes it great for smaller doors. The round satin stainless steel pocket door pull has concealed screw mounting and comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching: 2-3/4" Round Stainless Steel Flush Pull and 4-5/16" Round Stainless Steel Flush Pull

Specifications for the Satin Stainless Steel Round Pocket Door Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 1-31/32" (50 mm)
  • Total Depth: 15/32" (12 mm)
  • Door Cutout Depth: 3/8" (10 mm)
  • Projection: 1/16" (2 mm)
  • Door Cutout Opening Diameter: 31/32" (25 mm)
  • Lip: 3/16" (5 mm)
  • Comes packaged with all necessary mounting hardware.

Sold Individually

** Clearance Priced, limited quantities available.

Only (21) Left.
